name: sensor_patch_batch
description: Inspect up to eight patches from the actual recorded high-resolution RGB/world maps in one call. Points are normalized [row/(height-1), col/(width-1)] of calibrated agentview/wrist images, never mirrored policy images. Returns robust world coordinates, surface spread and EEF offsets. High-resolution metric depth statistics are reported only when recorded; historical null values mean not recorded. Missing high-resolution observations return an error, never a low-resolution substitute. Does not infer identity or success. With alignment_pair, select held-object and goal points in the same latest frame to compute an EEF XY-alignment target at unchanged height. This conditional calculation does not verify identity or holding.

radius.description: Patch radius in pixels. For a single pixel, use back_project.

alignment_pair.description: Optional [held-object point index, goal point index] into points. Requires confirmed holding, unchanged orientation and an explicit latest step. Returns a conditional EEF target for XY alignment only; no lowering, collision or holding guarantee.
